authority: This is the CANONICAL source for all schema definitions. All prose documentation (STANDARD_*.md, VOCABULARY.md) references this file. If prose contradicts schema, the schema wins.

validation_rules: description word count must be between 100 and 250
location_slug must exist in locations table
all slugs in persons_involved must exist in persons table
all slugs in texts_involved must exist in texts table
all slugs in concepts_involved must exist in concepts table
at least one [LINK:slug] markup in description
final sentence must state historiographical significance
bio_html total word count must be between 1200 and 2200
must begin with person name (not 'This figure...')
material grounding required for historical figures
named scholars with specific arguments in scholarly debates
at least 3 entity links [LINK:slug]
bibliography in DGWE format
must begin with title in italics (not 'This text...')
word count must match the range for its text_type
textual tradition section required for PRIMARY_SOURCE, COMMENTARY, TREATISE
named scholars with specific arguments in Modern Scholarship
at least 3 entity links [LINK:slug]
bibliography in DGWE format

essay_word_count.note: DRAFT essays may be shorter; target on expansion

validation_rules: short_description must be 3-6 sentences of plain scholarly prose
zodiac_sign required when is_canonical_twelve is true; null otherwise
concept_slug, when present, must exist in concepts table
attribution of any zodiac correspondence must name its source (e.g. Pernety 1758) — never presented as universal alchemical doctrine
no endorsement of transmutation; report historical belief only
bibliography in DGWE format
ACTOR_TERM or ANALYST_TERM must be explicitly declared in opening paragraph
definition_short must be 60-120 words plain text
definition_long must be 1500-2500 words valid HTML
ACTOR_TERM: material grounding required (equipment, dangers, observable results)
ANALYST_TERM: historiographical disputes required (who invented this category?)
named scholars with specific arguments in Scholarly Significance
Related Concepts written as prose sentences (not bullets)
at least 3 [LINK:slug] entity links
bibliography 8-15 references in DGWE format

era.description: Historical period. Controls timeline filtering and site organization.

role_primary.description: Primary role of person. Not exclusive — captures the most salient role.

text_type.description: Type of text. Controls word count requirements in text_description.

category_type.description: Concept classification. ACTOR_TERM: historical practitioner's concept. ANALYST_TERM: modern scholarly category imposed retrospectively.

operation.description: Alchemical or chemical operation. Used for concept filtering.

zodiac_sign.description: Zodiac sign mapped to a canonical alchemical process. Correspondence per Pernety, Dictionnaire mytho-hermetique (1758). Pernety's twelve operations are RELATED TO BUT DISTINCT FROM George Ripley's twelve gates (1471): Pernety substitutes Fixation, Digestion, Distillation and drops Conjunction, Putrefaction, Cibation, Exaltation. Only the canonical twelve processes carry a zodiac_sign.

confidence.description: Confidence in data accuracy. HIGH: well-documented; MEDIUM: probable; LOW: speculative.

review_status.description: Editorial review state. DRAFT: AI-generated; REVIEWED: human-checked; VERIFIED: scholar-confirmed.

source_method.description: How data was sourced. MANUAL: human-written; AI_ASSISTED: AI with human review; SCHOLARSHIP_BASED: direct citation.

slug_conventions.format: lowercase, hyphens only, no special characters

bibliography_format.name: DGWE
bibliography_format.description: Dictionary of Gnosis and Western Esotericism model
bibliography_format.pattern: Author Last, First. Title. Publisher, Year.
bibliography_format.example: Newman, William R. Atoms and Alchemy: Chymistry and the Transformation of Matter. University of Chicago Press, 2006.
